_selection: KyberBridge.choose_map_key: a HOME world (Kamino, Geonosis) is always Galactic Assault. Otherwise trigger 'fleet' when a fleet defends (-> Supremacy); trigger 'garrison' otherwise, narrowed by held_by (the current owner): GA for a Republic world, Blast for a Separatist one, CO-OP for Felucia. Ryloth is always Starfighter Assault (trigger 'any'). A space lane is a capital-ship boarding co-op: the MAP is the defender's ship (defender_faction) and the coop_role is 'attack' (Mode9) when player_faction == request.attacker, 'defend' (ModeDefend) otherwise.
